ViSoBERT: A Pre-Trained Language Model for Vietnamese Social Media Text Processing
English and Chinese, known as resource-rich languages, have witnessed the strong development of transformer-based language models for natural language processing tasks.Although Vietnam has approximately 100M people speaking Vietnamese, several pre-trained models, e.g., PhoBERT, ViBERT, and vELEC-TRA, performed well on general Vietnamese NLP tasks, including POS tagging and named entity recognition.These pre-trained language models are still limited to Vietnamese social media tasks.In this paper,
